task.description:
WF-03 Step 0.5 — Issue registry + GitHub filing for 4 QRY bugs found by TEST-RUNNER rework3.

For each issue below:
1. Create/update entry in docs/issues/ with the issue details
2. File a real GitHub issue via: gh issue create --title '<title>' --body '<body>' --label 'bug'
3. Record the GitHub issue number

Issues to file:

1. ISS-QRY-ALLOWLIST-KIND-01 (CRITICAL)
   Title: QRY: allowlist.zig hardcodes .kind=.jsonb_key for all entity_filterable_keys rows
   Body: In allowlist.zig:124, all rows loaded from entity_filterable_keys are assigned .kind=.jsonb_key. The design (qry-01-04-entity-query.md) specifies that typed columns from entity_definitions.definition_json.fields (where queried=true) should be merged and have .kind=.typed_column. The missing merge means typed-column entities emit payload ->> $2 SQL against tables without a payload column, causing sqlstate=42703 and HTTP 503 for QRY-01 tests qry01_valid_eq_filter_returns_matching_rows, qry01_filter_value_is_positional_param_not_interpolated, qry01_audit_event_recorded_without_filter_values. Requirements: QRY-01, QRY-02.

2. ISS-QRY-RESPONSE-FIELD-NAME-01 (MAJOR)
   Title: QRY: filter_field_not_allowlisted error response omits rejected field name
   Body: When a filter field is not allowlisted, the HTTP 400 response body contains error code filter_field_not_allowlisted but omits the name of the rejected field. QRY-02 AC requires the rejected field name to appear in the error detail. Test: qry02_non_allowlisted_field_returns_400. Requirements: QRY-02.

3. ISS-QRY-CURSOR-PARSE-01 (MAJOR)
   Title: QRY: pagination cursor rejected on second page for default no-sort case
   Body: The cursor returned from the first page is rejected with HTTP 400 when submitted in the second page request. Root cause suspected: sort-fingerprint in the cursor does not round-trip for the default no-sort case (empty sort spec). Test: qry03_cursor_pagination_returns_next_page. Requirements: QRY-03.

4. ISS-QRY-AUDIT-SCHEMA-01 (MAJOR)
   Title: QRY: qry04 cross-tenant test references audit_entries.created_at — column is named timestamp
   Body: Test qry04_cross_tenant_probe_returns_empty_envelope queries audit_entries.created_at but the column is named timestamp (not created_at). sqlstate=42703. This is a test bug, not an implementation bug. Requirements: QRY-04.

Return PASS after all 4 issues are filed on GitHub and recorded locally.

result.summary: Filed 4 QRY bug issues on GitHub and created local registry entries. GitHub issues: #823 (ISS-QRY-ALLOWLIST-KIND-01, CRITICAL — allowlist.zig .kind merge missing), #824 (ISS-QRY-RESPONSE-FIELD-NAME-01, MAJOR — rejected field name omitted from error detail), #825 (ISS-QRY-CURSOR-PARSE-01, MAJOR — cursor rejected on second page for no-sort case), #826 (ISS-QRY-AUDIT-SCHEMA-01, MAJOR — test references wrong audit_entries column name). No prior matching GitHub issues found; no ID collisions.
result.next_action: Route to ISSUE-FIXER for WF-03 Steps 1–2 diagnosis and fix of each ISS
